meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 命令行工具(需 Node.js 22+ 与 FFmpeg)帮你搭建、检查并渲染视频项目:先建项目、检查代码、预览时间线,等你批准后才生成视频;若构建或渲染失败,它也会诊断原因。
howto.when: 当你说要用 HyperFrames 创建或修改视频、排查构建/渲染报错,或提到它的命令(如 init、render、check 等)时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 HyperFrames 视频项目
say.note: 运行 init 搭建项目骨架

say.text: 检查一下这个视频项目有没有问题
say.note: 运行 lint 和 check 检查代码与画面

say.text: 把这个项目渲染成 out.mp4
say.note: 先预览时间线,你批准后才出片

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI to scaffold, check, and render video projects. It creates the project, runs checks, previews the timeline, and only renders after your approval. It also diagnoses build or render failures.
howto.when_en: When you ask to create or edit a HyperFrames video, fix build or render errors, or mention its commands such as init, render, or check.

say_en.text: Help me create a new HyperFrames video project.
say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.
Runs lint and check on code and visuals.
Previews the timeline first; renders after approval.
